source_card_current.label: Example2.27 hinge loss
source_card_current.fallback: For the actual hinge: negative margin gives{0}, equality gives every -alpha z for alpha in[0,1], positive margin gives{-z}.
source_card_current.plain: For every z and x in finite-dimensional real Euclidean space, the full ambient hinge subdifferential follows these three cases. At equality no boundary support is omitted.
source_card_current.relationship: Coordinate-free finite-dimensional real inner-product space represents Rd. Finite real hinge is embedded into the shared EReal support definition; no nonzero z or bounded domain is assumed. The affine foundation is valid in arbitrary real inner-product spaces.

contract.model: Deterministic finite-dimensional real Euclidean convex analysis of the exact hinge loss.
contract.assumptions: No additional assumptions on z or x; full ambient global supports. Explicit finite dimension matches Rd. Both affine components are proved proper, convex, finite and continuous, rather than assumed qualifying.
contract.parameters: Every z,x and every candidate g; all test points y; all real alpha in the inclusive interval[0,1].
contract.regret: No algorithm or regret bound claimed.
contract.guarantee: Full three-branch equality, strict singleton cases and the entire boundary segment, including z=0.
